title: k8squad-crds chart values
description: Validated values for the standalone k8squad-crds chart (ADR-0002 Option B). The chart owns the eleven ksquad.io CRDs; installing it is the opt-in, so the only value is the uninstall keep policy.

keep.description: Annotate CRDs with helm.sh/resource-policy: keep so helm uninstall never deletes CRDs or their CRs. Default true.
